recruitmentDialogue.BillyGreeting: Oh, you almost scared me to death. Wait, too late for that! Anyways, I thought you were another one of those crazy cultists.
recruitmentDialogue.BillyJoinCue: All right. I'll come with you.
recruitmentDialogue.BillyWhatAreYouCue: Technically? A violation of several natural laws. Practically? Still me. Still thinking. Still shooting straighter than most of the living. Look, I get it. I'm not supposed to be up and walking around. I've filed that complaint myself. But until the universe processes the paperwork, I've got things to do.
recruitmentDialogue.BillyWhyHereCue: Same reason as you, I'm guessing. The world's ending, demons are everywhere, and nobody else is doing the job right. I follow Irori. Self-perfection. Discipline. Mastery. Turns out death is just an unexpected training condition. So here I am. Improving. Adapting. Trying not to fall apart, literally or philosophically.
recruitmentDialogue.BillyDangerousCue: To enemies? Absolutely. To you? Not unless you start chanting in Abyssal or sprout extra limbs. I've got standards.
recruitmentDialogue.BillyPlanAnswer: What do you plan to do now?
recruitmentDialogue.BillyPlanCue: Keep moving. Keep improving. Keep putting arrows into things that deserve it. And maybe, eventually, figure out whether this is something to fix or something to master.

bowQuestDialogue.BillyBowQuestStartCue: That's my bow! How did this crazy bitch get it? I left it at the temple near Jalmeray... no. I was holding it. Sun-warmed stone, salt incense, the training hall bell, then nothing until I woke up in a crypt with dirt in my mouth and prayer beads in my ribs.
bowQuestDialogue.BillyBowQuestTempleAnswer: Slow down. What is the last thing you remember from Jalmeray?
bowQuestDialogue.BillyBowQuestTempleCue: Evening practice. Three breaths, one shot. Draw, hold, release. Again. Again. My fingers were split raw, and I was proud of it. Master Kalas said discipline is what remains when terror arrives. Then cold candle-smoke, a hand on my shoulder, and my bow hitting the floor. Or maybe that was me.
bowQuestDialogue.BillyBowQuestHosillaAnswer: Hosilla having it means someone carried it across half the Inner Sea to Kenabres.
bowQuestDialogue.BillyBowQuestHosillaCue: That's the cheerful arithmetic, yes. A cultist chief didn't find Jalmeray temple property in a barrel of discount blasphemy. Someone took this from me, or from my body, and brought it under Kenabres. I very much want to know which version is worse.
bowQuestDialogue.BillyBowQuestDisciplineAnswer: The bow still punishes chaotic foes. Irori's discipline survived with you.
bowQuestDialogue.BillyBowQuestDisciplineCue: Comforting in the most upsetting possible way. If the bow remembers my vows better than I remember my death, maybe it can point us backward. Not literally, I assume. Though if it starts humming, everyone stay calm.
bowQuestDialogue.BillyBowQuestEndAnswer: We'll find out what happened to you.
bowQuestDialogue.BillyBowQuestEndCue: Good. Because if my last living day ended near Jalmeray, then my first undead step under Kenabres was not an accident. And if someone dragged me across the continent to become this, I intend to discuss personal growth with them at arrowpoint.

act1QuestDialogue.BillyAct1JalmerayAnswer: Someone at Defender's Heart recognized one of your training phrases.
act1QuestDialogue.BillyAct1JalmerayCue: Three breaths, one shot? That is a Jalmeray temple drill. If someone recorded my arrival in Kenabres, the merchants or guards in Market Square may have kept the ledger. Assuming the demons left anything legible.
act1QuestDialogue.BillyAct1RecordAnswer: We found a scorched record about a Jalmeray archer.
act1QuestDialogue.BillyAct1RecordCue: Foreign Iroran novice, transferred under Hosilla's authority, body absent from the second count. Efficient paperwork for stealing a corpse. The receiving mark belongs to the Tower of Estrod. We should search whatever cache the cultists left there.
act1QuestDialogue.BillyAct1TunicAnswer: This tunic was hidden in the cult cache.
act1QuestDialogue.BillyAct1TunicCue: Temple work, altered for a corpse expected to keep fighting. There is another notation inside the collar: "north convoy, retrieval beneath the split earth." Cryptic, but the road to Drezen appears determined to provide us with both halves.
